title: Reptilians as dinosaur hybrids made by the Nordics

tellings.quote: slave race. Why not take dinosaurs and hybridize them genetically with themselves?

plain: A philosopher and researcher named Jason Jorjani, speaking on the podcast of host Jesse Michels, tells an idea about Earth's distant past, drawing on a work called Closer Encounters. He describes the "Nordics", tall, human-looking beings from UFO lore, wanting a slave race, and asks why they would not take dinosaurs and genetically blend them with themselves, which is how he accounts for the "Reptilians", reptile-like beings of the same lore. If true, it would mean some beings said to visit Earth were made, not born.
